turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Anna Kaminski?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. Can I also confirm the email we have on file?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, that's still the right one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me just pull up your account. One moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, I have it here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $2,365.23.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Honestly, I can't afford that amount. I've been off work sick since May.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I've been dealing with a lot of anxiety.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm only bringing home about $3320 a month now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
